ONE DECISION AT A TIME

Read less. Do more.

Each page gives you one job, a clear sequence, a prompt you can copy into ChatGPT, a deliverable and a rule for deciding when to move on. The instructions—not the AI—drive the process.

THE FULL SEQUENCE

Eight phases. In order.

Follow from the beginning or jump to the phase you need. Later phases depend on earlier evidence.

010 / 4 complete

DEFINE

Capture the idea

Give ChatGPT the full story and set your standards before asking it to produce anything.

01Open a dedicated ChatGPT Project02Set your quality standards03Tell the whole business story04Build the pass-or-fail checklist
Open phase
020 / 4 complete

VERIFY

Research the market

Look globally, regionally and locally. Find actual competitors and reasons customers will choose you.

01Research the strongest global models02Check Caribbean and regional alternatives03Audit the actual local competition04Make a real-world feasibility call
Open phase
030 / 4 complete

PREVIEW

Visualize the business

Show the idea in a real website preview before you invest in building all the infrastructure.

01Sketch the customer journey02Generate a first visual website03Show the preview to real customers04Turn the visual concept into a working plan
Open phase
040 / 4 complete

DECIDE

Prove the economics

How will it make money, qualify for opportunities, support your country and expand?

01Calculate how money actually comes in02Connect the offer to a genuine development priority03Find grants, accelerators and capital pathways04Ask whether this can grow past the first island
Open phase
050 / 4 complete

ESTABLISH

Look legitimate online

Choose a strategic name, then set up the minimum credible digital footprint.

01Choose a name customers can understand and remember02Set up the domain, email and SEO foundation03Claim a legitimate Google Business Profile—if eligible04Create the right social and messaging accounts
Open phase
060 / 4 complete

BUILD

Build the real website

Turn the tested prototype into a reliable customer-facing website and only then add CRM or dashboards.

01Turn the preview into a production build brief02Run a real SEO and mobile launch audit03Secure the backend, accounts and customer data04Add a simple CRM or dashboard only when needed
Open phase
070 / 4 complete

SELL

Get customers & partners

Choose Google or Meta ads based on buying behavior, then develop high-value partnerships.

01Google Ads or Facebook/Instagram Ads?02Launch one controlled campaign03Build local and regional distribution partnerships04Use organizations and speaking to open doors
Open phase
080 / 4 complete

SCALE

Improve and expand

Use actual operating data to decide what to fix, automate or replicate.

01Review the business every week02Automate the repetitive parts carefully03Run one expansion experiment04Keep improving your business source of truth
Open phase
